sentences.en: You are not old enough to go swimming by yourself.
sentences.zh: 你还不至于独自去游泳。

sentences.en: In summer, we used to go swimming in the river.
sentences.zh: 夏天的时候，我们常去河里游泳。

sentences.en: I often go swimming at the beach in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天我经常去海滩游泳。

senses.zh: 游泳的；游泳用的；善于游泳的；晕眩的
